Copied without modification from crcmod-1.7/python3/crcmod/:

The optional C extension python3/src/_crcfunext.c is not included.
crcmod.py imports crcmod._crcfunpy when that extension is absent.

launch_chffrplus.sh puts this directory's parent, starpilot/third_party,
at the front of PYTHONPATH before the repository root. import crcmod
resolves here on a device whose /usr/local/venv cannot be written.
